experiment: R6: validate detached-descendant detection and apply it to the two recorded motifs
question: Can either recorded exact motif produce two simultaneous detached, recoverable descendants whose copying and helper histories are confined to one declared founder?

matching.space: all translations on open boundaries; full footprint and two empty exterior cells on each side
matching.time: period-one template at every saved discrete time
matching.initial_founder: the explicitly inoculated footprint; every nonzero founding cell must be represented in each descendant

ancestry.trace: complete ordered native copy events for every update; validate before/after values against saved rows
ancestry.copy_origin: set-valued initial-cell copying support; equal-value arrivals add alternatives, never create additional identities
ancestry.destructive_writes: erasure clears copying support; replacement resets it; mutation gives unknown copying origin and is excluded from certified descendants
ancestry.partners: old-row helper sites are recorded separately from copying parents; descendant dependencies must remain within the founder
ancestry.branching: two disjoint guarded matches at the same t>=1, each exclusively descended from and covering all nonzero founder cells
limits: operational numerical copying support, not biological ancestry
mutation-created and changed templates are conservatively excluded
distributed/noncontiguous collectives and phase cycles are outside this detector

recovery.selection: earliest qualifying time, lexicographically first pair; at most two probes per run
recovery.intervention: extract each child footprint, translate to x112 in an otherwise empty width256 world under the same norm
recovery.criterion: exact template remains present at every saved time, including t0; probes recorded separately for both children

calibration_controls.expected: detached common-founder pair and two successful recovery probes; lacks partner assistance, so not a collective reproduction result
two persistent detached equal templates but no common-founder branch
persistent detached translation but no branch
unguarded domain expansion but no detached pair

confirmation.reserved: do not inspect until calibration expectations and detector tests pass; hold all matching and ancestry rules fixed

units: deliberately chosen deterministic inoculated worlds; translated placements are robustness checks, not independent random biological replicates; no population confidence intervals
decision_rule: Only report a candidate as an observed dependency-supported detached reproduction case if geometry, exclusive full-founder copying support, internal helper support and both isolated recovery probes pass. Report calibration copying separately and retain every negative outcome.
next_if_negative: The detector core is calibrated, but partner-assisted detached reproduction remains unestablished. Next obtain an independently verified native positive case or predeclare a bounded candidate campaign, including distributed and phase-aware alternatives.
